```{r,echo=FALSE}
blanks = c("What percent of TOTAL is PART?",
"PART is what percent of TOTAL?",
"PART out of TOTAL is what percent?",
"What percent is PART out of TOTAL?",
"PERC% of TOTAL is what?",
"What is PERC% of TOTAL?",
"What out of TOTAL is PERC%?",
"PERC% is what out of TOTAL?",
"PERC% of what is PART?",
"PART is PERC% of what?",
"PART out of what is PERC%?",
"PERC% is PART out of what?")

eqs = c("\\frac{x}{100}\\cdot TOTAL = PART",
        "PART = \\frac{x}{100}\\cdot TOTAL",
        "\\frac{PART}{TOTAL}=\\frac{x}{100}",
        "\\frac{x}{100}=\\frac{PART}{TOTAL}",
        "\\frac{60}{100}\\cdot TOTAL = x",
        "x = \\frac{PERC}{100}\\cdot TOTAL",
        "\\frac{x}{TOTAL} = \\frac{PERC}{100}",
        "\\frac{PERC}{100} = \\frac{x}{TOTAL}",
        "\\frac{PERC}{100}\\cdot x = PART",
        "PART = \\frac{PERC}{100}\\cdot x",
        "\\frac{PART}{x} = \\frac{PERC}{100}",
        "\\frac{PERC}{100} = \\frac{PART}{x}")

eq2 = c("x = \\frac{PART}{TOTAL}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{PART}{TOTAL}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{PART}{TOTAL}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{PART}{TOTAL}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{PERC}{100}\\cdot TOTAL",
        "x = \\frac{PERC}{100}\\cdot TOTAL",
        "x = \\frac{PERC}{100}\\cdot TOTAL",
        "x = \\frac{PERC}{100}\\cdot TOTAL",
        "x = \\frac{PART}{PERC}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{PART}{PERC}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{PART}{PERC}\\cdot 100",
        "x = \\frac{PART}{PERC}\\cdot 100")

while(T){
    part = sample(1:200,1)
    whole = sample(1:200,1)
    perc = part/whole*100
    if(perc%%1==0 && perc<100 && whole != 100){break}
}
# ii = sample(1:length(blanks),1)
ii = sample(1:4,1)
blank = blanks[ii]
qstr = gsub("PART",part,blank,fixed=T)
qstr = gsub("PERC",perc,qstr,fixed=T)
qstr = gsub("TOTAL",whole,qstr,fixed=T)

eq = eqs[ii]
eq = gsub("PART",part,eq,fixed=T)
eq = gsub("PERC",perc,eq,fixed=T)
eq = gsub("TOTAL",whole,eq,fixed=T)

eq2 = eq2[ii]
eq2 = gsub("PART",part,eq2,fixed=T)
eq2 = gsub("PERC",perc,eq2,fixed=T)
eq2 = gsub("TOTAL",whole,eq2,fixed=T)

if(ii %in% 1:4){
    astr = paste0(perc,"%",collapse="")
    aa = gsub("what percent",astr,qstr,fixed=T)
    aa = gsub("What percent",astr,aa,fixed=T)
    extype = "string"
}
if(ii %in% 5:8){
    astr = paste0(part)
    aa = gsub("what",astr,qstr,fixed=T)
    aa = gsub("What",astr,aa,fixed=T)
    extype = "num"
}
if(ii %in% 9:12){
    astr = paste0(whole)
    aa = gsub("what",astr,qstr,fixed=T)
    aa = gsub("What",astr,aa,fixed=T)
    extype = "num"
}

aa = gsub("?",".",aa,fixed=T)
```
